lines.en: I have no wings; my walk is heavy.

lines.zh: 脚掌拍在草地上，一步步压过去。
lines.en: My feet slap the grass, step by step.
I patrol the edge of the plains.

lines.zh: 我的背脊一起一伏，像小山。
lines.en: My spine rises and falls like a small hill.

lines.zh: 我一抬脚，草就贴到泥里。
lines.en: Each time I lift a foot, the grass goes flat.
I look for something worth charging.

lines.zh: 我的头很低，随时准备顶。
lines.en: My head hangs low, ready to butt.

lines.zh: 白天的草原，是我的猎场。
lines.en: The daytime plains are my hunting ground.
I walk slowly, then suddenly surge.
Gravel is pressed into the soil under me.

lines.zh: 我走过一片花，花全折了。
lines.en: I cross a patch of flowers; they all bend.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，停了一下。
lines.en: I lift a leg and hold it a moment.
The grass ahead is moving.

lines.zh: 我一转弯，地面划出一道弧。
lines.en: I turn, and the ground is scored in an arc.

lines.zh: 我杵在原地，鼻孔一开一合。
lines.en: I stand rooted, nostrils flaring.

lines.zh: 这具身体没有翅膀，却很重。
lines.en: No wings, but a heavy body.
I lower my head and sniff the grass.
I am reading the wind.

lines.zh: 尾巴一下一下扫开脚边的草。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the grass from my feet.
Ancient blood sounds in this body.
There are old splits in my scales.

lines.zh: 我在等一个足够大的声音。
lines.en: I am waiting for a big enough sound.

lines.zh: 这片草原很安静，太安静。
lines.en: The plains are quiet. Too quiet.
I raise my snout to the sun.

lines.zh: 我兽性上头时，连草都咬。
lines.en: When the fury rises, I bite even grass.

lines.zh: 我把脚在地上刨了两下。
lines.en: I scrape the ground twice with a foot.
A bug crawls over my foot.

lines.zh: 我伏在草里，像一截倒下的树。
lines.en: I lie in the grass like a fallen trunk.
You are standing on my plains.
I lower my head and see you.

lines.zh: 你这一身，掂起来没多少肉。
lines.en: That frame of yours would not weigh much.
First, I will roar.
Stepping back is wise of you.

lines.zh: 你那面盾，经不住我一顶。
lines.en: That shield of yours will not take one butt from me.

lines.zh: 站在我四面的人，我都要撞。
lines.en: Anyone at my four sides gets a charge.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味，这草原没有过。
lines.en: Your scent has never been on these plains.
I step forward and the ground moves.
You want to ride me? Say it plainly.
I know a saddle, and I know being thrown.

lines.zh: 你的手别往我脖子上放。
lines.en: Do not put your hand on my neck.
I am sniffing for a saddle.
You stand too steadily. I dislike it.
One roar from me, and you slow down.

lines.zh: 你膝盖打着颤，我数得清。
lines.en: Your knees are shaking, and I can count each tremor.

lines.zh: 我吼出来，脚下的土都松开。
lines.en: I roar, and the dirt shifts under my feet.
That split my scales.
Pain does not frighten me; it angers me.
My blood drips onto the grass.
You knocked my head aside.

lines.zh: 低吼从喉咙深处挤出来。
lines.en: A growl grinds up from deep in my throat.
I carve this debt into my bones.
My feet scrape faster.

lines.zh: 我还站得起，下一撞照样狠。
lines.en: I can still rise, and the next charge hits as hard.
Then come again — we shall see who falls first.
I will not lower my jaws for that.
You hold meat up for me to see?
I want a whole cut.
Set it down and step well back.
I smell blood, but not from this.

lines.zh: 这么一小块，塞牙缝都不够。
lines.en: That morsel would not even fill a tooth gap.
I do not accept being fed.
You hold it out as if taming a horse.
I prefer my food running.

lines.zh: 收走它，我的耐性到头了。
lines.en: Take it away; my patience has run out.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，没动摇我。
lines.en: You hit my chest and did not move me.
I shoved back once.

lines.zh: 挡在前面，我就从你身上过。
lines.en: Stand in front and I will go over you.
That flattened the grass.

lines.zh: 我的体重是你看得见的。
lines.en: My weight is plain to see.

lines.zh: 你被顶出去，脚在土上犁了三道。
lines.en: You slide back, your feet ploughing three furrows.
My shoulder is harder than stone.

lines.zh: 离我的腿远一点，别挨着。
lines.en: Stay clear of my legs; do not press against them.

lines.zh: 地上留了两个深坑，一人一个。
lines.en: Two deep pits in the ground, one for each of us.
Again, and I use my head.
At times like this I am fierce.
Kin meet by testing strength first.
I do not call; I scrape the earth.
These plains hold only one of me.
Do not stand in the middle watching.
I still remember how to throw a rider.

lines.zh: 你问这个，我兽性会上来。
lines.en: Ask that and the fury rises.
Plains matters are settled with horns.
I am turning. You had better leave.
Not in the mood today.
I take up a whole log.
It splits in my jaws.
I push this boulder along.
I pick up an old saddle.
It is not my size.

lines.zh: 我一低头，把它掀到草里。
lines.en: One dip of my head flings it into the grass.
There is the smell of leather.
I pin it and sniff.

lines.zh: 这些零碎，我一样都用不上。
lines.en: Not one of these trifles is of use to me.

lines.zh: 我叼住它，一甩扔上背脊。
lines.en: I snatch it up and flip it onto my spine.
The grass moved.
I raise my head. I heard it.
One charge covers this distance.
First, the roar.

lines.zh: 我的头压低，正对你的胸口。
lines.en: My head lowers, aimed at your chest.
The roar has slowed you.
I have picked the landing spot.
This size can be moved.
My feet are already scraping.
Open ground behind you. Good.
I do not go around. I charge straight.
You had better not stand still.

lines.zh: 风把你的汗味送到我鼻前。
lines.en: The wind brings your sweat to my snout.
The fury is rising.

lines.zh: 我一步比一步重地碾过去。
lines.en: Each step I take grinds closer than the last.
You retreat; my stride is longer.
My roar slows you down.

lines.zh: 我不需要跑，我只需要撞。
lines.en: I need no sprint, only the impact.

lines.zh: 我的鼻尖，始终对着你的方向。
lines.en: My snout stays pointed at you the whole way.
The plains are flat. Nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我偏着身子，把你往栅栏挤。
lines.en: I angle my bulk to crowd you toward the fence.
You missed half a step.

lines.zh: 蹄下的土一翻，我冲起来了。
lines.en: The soil turns under my feet and I break into a charge.

lines.zh: 这声音是我的脚在刨地。
lines.en: That sound is my feet scraping.

lines.zh: 你回头的工夫，我又近了两步。
lines.en: In the time you glanced back, I gained two steps.

lines.zh: 我的影子铺在你前面的地上。
lines.en: My shadow lies across the ground ahead of you.
Retreat further and you reach the river.
I have this impact measured.

lines.zh: 喘息声沉下来，像远处的雷。
lines.en: My panting deepens, like distant thunder.
I lower my head and charge; the ground splits.
This sends you flying.
My head strikes heavier than a sword.
The roar leaves you unsteady.
I bite your pauldron.
I shake my head and you are thrown up.
I rear and come down.
This charge flattens all the grass.
My tail catches you.
You pull back; I do not chase far.
I pant, nostrils flaring.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我全部的力气。
lines.en: That was all my strength.

lines.zh: 你还没倒，那就再来一下。
lines.en: You have not fallen. Then here is another.
Once more, and I will be crueller.

lines.zh: 我在草原上撑起四条腿。
lines.en: I brace on four legs on the plains.

lines.zh: 我没有翅膀，这是第一件知道的事。
lines.en: I have no wings. That is the first thing I learn.
My first breath tastes of grass.

lines.zh: 我的鳞还软，很快就硬了。
lines.en: My scales are soft, then harden quickly.
The sun is high. I look up.
I take one step and the ground answers.
There are sheep far off. I see them clearly.

lines.zh: 四只爪子刨开土，站稳了。
lines.en: Four claws dig into the soil and take hold.
The plains are wide. I claim half.
I roar once to test my voice.

lines.zh: 这一声吼，越过整片草原。
lines.en: That roar carries across the whole plain.
The horses ran the other way.

lines.zh: 我记得有人给我上过鞍。
lines.en: I remember someone saddling me.
And I remember throwing him.
I choose this rise.

lines.zh: 从这里，我能看见所有靠近的东西。
lines.en: From here I can see anything approach.
I wait for the first to dare.
The fury rolls inside me.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的鳞，只让我更怒。
lines.en: Fire licks my scales and only angers me.

lines.zh: 我从半空砸下来，泥土四溅。
lines.en: I slam down from the sky, dirt flying.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的鼻子，我猛地抬头。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I jerk my head up.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得侧了两步。
lines.en: The blast shoves me two steps sideways.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 有咒力钻进来，我的腿一软。
lines.en: A curse slips in and my legs weaken.
Too hungry to roar.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我的背上，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I shudder.

lines.zh: 草原不见了，脚下空荡荡的。
lines.en: The plains are gone; only emptiness below.
